description: PAID — $0.25 USDC. Everything resolve_price_event returns, plus a signed decision_id, an integrity hash over the evidence, and every candle that determined the outcome. This is the citable artifact: use it when the answer may later have to be defended to a counterparty, not when you just need to know. KEEP THE decision_id. It is self-contained — anyone you show it to can authenticate it for free with decode_decision_id, and confirm the verdict still holds for $0.02 with verify_decision, without you having to supply anything else. Pays automatically from the configured wallet.
